# AUBG Academic Advisor

> A degree planner for students of the American University in Bulgaria (AUBG). It builds a
> semester-by-semester plan from the AY 2025-26 catalog for the majors and minors a student picks,
> taking completed courses, prerequisites, class standing and GenEd rules into account.

The planner is an unofficial tool. Students must confirm their choices with their academic advisor and
register through the official AUBG system.

## App

- [Academic Advisor](/): pick majors, minors and a Business concentration, import a transcript, then review and edit the generated plan.

## Requirements

- [AUBG majors](/majors): every major with its required courses, electives, credits and prerequisites, one page each (for example `/majors/computer-science`).
- [AUBG minors](/minors): the same for every minor (for example `/minors/finance`).
- [General education](/general-education): the GenEd categories, how many courses each needs, and the courses that count.

## Notes

- Plans follow the AUBG Academic Catalog AY 2025-26 and the Fall 2026 course schedule.
- Shared plans are opened from links of the form `/p/<token>`; they contain a student's own selections and are not meant to be crawled.
